text:
maya: Alert — embeddings-eu-west1 showing gradual memory climb and ~3.9% errors since 22:55 UTC. suspect kvcache churn under heavy prefix reuse. proposing a hotfix image + controlled cutover to eu-west2 during the 23:15-23:45 change window.
deploy-bot: Deploy request DR-2026-501 created. image: registry.redwood/internal/embeddings:v3.2.2-hotpatch. rollout plan: 4% canary -> 30% -> 100%.
duncan: prefer a conservative first step and pinned fallback. suggest 4% for 6m, then 30% for 6m. keep v3.2.0 pinned for instant rollback.
selena: platform ok. eu-west2 lab runs show mem churn down ~33%, p95 unchanged. i'll own telemetry and traces during the window.
maya: rollback criteria: immediate rollback to v3.2.0 if errors exceed 1.5% OR p95 increases >250ms sustained for 3 minutes OR any OOMs. ops-bot: rollback triggers recorded.
duncan: need expedited infra lead signoff. paging @rana for greenlight and cadence confirmation.
rana: rana: approved via DM. cadence accepted: 4%@6m, 30%@6m. proceed to full only if no regressions. post release note to #release-notes after cutoff.
ops-bot: Scheduled DR-2026-501 for 23:15 UTC. Temporary alert ALRT-8042 created for p95>250ms or errors>1.5%. escalation chain: oncall -> infra-lead.
releasebot: Release note attached to DR-2026-501: "Embeddings v3.2.2-hotpatch — kvcache stabilization" https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2026-501
maya: Operators on deck: maya, selena, duncan. If any segfaults or OOMs, immediate rollback. otherwise ramp per cadence. will update with final status after the hold window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
